events.title: This is what easy conditions look like on the Dempster Highway.
events.thought: Nearing the end of the Dempster — and the beginning of the road into Tuk.
events.photoCaption: This is what 880 kilometers to the Arctic Ocean looks like on the Dempster Highway.

events.title: The Arctic Ocean, Tuktoyaktuk
events.thought: The Arctic Ocean at Tuktoyaktuk. The front bumper dipped in.
events.photoCaption: Waldo's hood and bumper frame the Beaufort Sea at Tuktoyaktuk — the Arctic Ocean at journey's end.

events.title: Arrival at Tuktoyaktuk
events.thought: We made it. Tuk, the Arctic Ocean, and every single mile between here and home.
events.photoCaption: Two travelers at the Tuktoyaktuk welcome sign — the end of a 61-day journey from Pennsylvania to the Arctic Ocean.
